rules.text: Preorder items are final sale and not eligible for return or exchange.
rules.reviewNote: The quote only says preorders are not eligible for return; it does not mention exchanges or that they are 'final sale.' The summary adds extra information.

rules.text: Pre-order items are final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange.
rules.quote: Pre-order items are final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange.

rules.text: Returns are only accepted for purchases made on Skechers.com.
rules.quote: We only accept returns for purchases made on Skechers.com.

rules.text: Allow 10 business days for return processing after the return is received.
rules.quote: Please allow 10 business days once the return is received.

rules.text: If unable to refund the original payment method, an e-gift card will be issued via email.
rules.quote: If we are unable to refund the original form of payment, an E-gift card will be issued via email.

rules.text: Orders paid with Cash App Afterpay or Klarna returned in-store will receive an exchange or merchandise credit only.
rules.quote: Orders paid with Cash App Afterpay or Klarna will be issued an exchange or merchandise credit if returned to a store location.

rules.text: Free return postage applies only to orders within the return period.
rules.quote: Free return postage applies only to orders within the return period.
